metadata.query:
SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    architecture,
    segment,
    release_quarter,
    target_asp_usd,
    target_gross_margin_pct,
    tdp_watts,
    hbm_capacity_gb,
    memory_bandwidth_tbps,
    nvlink_version,
    nvlink_bandwidth_gbps,
    cuda_compute_capability,
    fp8_tflops,
    bf16_tflops
FROM gpu_products
ORDER BY
    release_quarter,
    target_asp_usd DESC;
